column5: MARITIME 3-J is a Phase 3 of maridebart cafraglutide at three doses against placebo in 279 adults, every site in Japan, with entry by the Japan Society for the Study of Obesity guideline (BMI ≥ 35 with one JASSO comorbidity, or 27 to 35 with two), primary outcome percent change in body weight at week 72, primary completion 2027-04-27 (registry, checked 2026-11-16). The book values US obesity, and the US gate is MARITIME-1 (NCT06858839, 2027-01-21), already priced on this asset; the ex-US value rides on exus_multiple, not on a Japanese filing. The registry indexes Overweight, Body Weight and Diabetes Mellitus, Type 2, none of which the condition 'Obesity Disease' matches

AZURE-CHINA is a Phase 2/3 of 432 participants, every site in China or Hong Kong: Part A's primary outcomes are AZD0780 plasma concentrations and PK parameters in 18 to 55 year olds, Part B's is relative change in LDL-C at 12 weeks, primary completion 2027-02-22 (registry, checked 2026-11-16). It seeks in China the LDL-C claim AZURE-LDL (NCT07000123) seeks in the US, and the book values the US. The registry indexes Dyslipidemias (D050171), which the condition 'Dyslipidaemia' misses only on spelling

MountainTAP-5 is a single-arm, open-label Phase 2 (254 planned, started 2026-07-27) of navlimetostat alone and in combinations in 'Advanced and/or Metastatic Solid Tumors With Homozygous MTAP Deletion', with brain cancer, melanoma, NSCLC and pancreatic cohorts; Part 1's primary outcome is objective response and Part 2's are dose-limiting toxicities and adverse events, primary completion 2028-08-15 (registry, checked 2026-11-16). The condition is 'Solid Tumors'. data/assumptions/bmy_navlimetostat.csv values first-line MTAP-deleted NSCLC and PDAC, gated by the randomised Phase 2/3s MountainTAP-29 (NCT07063745) and MountainTAP-30 (NCT07076121), and says 'Not modelled: the Phase 2 studies in pretreated NSCLC (MountainTAP-9) and other solid tumours'
